questions.question: When an article is sold at its marked price, it gives a profit of 25% If a discount of 9.6% is allowed on the marked price, then the profit percent will be:
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Let Cost Price (CP) = 100.

Profit = 25% when sold at MP → Marked Price (MP) = 125.

New Selling Price (SP) after 9.6% discount = 125 × (100 − 9.6)% = 125 × 90.4%.

New SP = 1.25 × 90.4 = 113.

Profit % = New SP − CP = 113 − 100 = 13%.

**∴ The correct answer is 13%.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Profit at Marked Price = 25%

Discount offered on Marked Price = 9.6%

**Formula Used:**

Profit % = [(SP − CP) ÷ CP] × 100

SP = MP − Discount

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/91c1e9e15627b6607edf5eefd3aa37fd7a420767b7425a6dd2d1a151a54e3fa0.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the Cost Price (CP) of the article be 100.

⇒ Since selling at MP gives 25% profit, MP = 100 + 25% of 100 = 125.

⇒ Discount amount = 9.6% of MP = (9.6 ÷ 100) × 125.

⇒ Discount amount = (9.6 × 1.25) = 12.

⇒ Selling Price (SP) = MP − Discount = 125 − 12 = 113.

⇒ Profit = SP − CP = 113 − 100 = 13.

⇒ Profit % = (13 ÷ 100) × 100 = 13%.

**∴ The correct answer is 13%.**

**__Additional Information__**

Relationship between CP and MP

The ratio of Cost Price to Marked Price is given by CP ÷ MP = (100 − Discount%) ÷ (100 + Profit%).

Successive Discounts

If two successive discounts of a% and b% are allowed, the equivalent single discount is (a + b − ab/100)%.

Effective Profit Percentage

Effective Profit % = Mark up % − Discount % − (Mark up % × Discount % ÷ 100).</p

questions.question: The bisector of ∠B in ΔABC meets AC at D. If AB = 10 cm, BC = 11 cm and AC = 14 cm, then the length of AD is∶
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

According to the Angle Bisector Theorem, the ratio AD : DC is equal to the ratio AB : BC.

Ratio AD : DC = 10 : 11

Total parts in AC = 10 + 11 = 21 units

Value of 21 units = 14 cm

Value of 10 units (AD) = (14 ÷ 21) × 10 = (2/3) × 10 = 20/3 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 20/3 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given: AB = 10 cm, BC = 11 cm, AC = 14 cm.

In ΔABC, BD is the internal bisector of ∠B.

Formula Used: Angle Bisector Theorem states AD/DC = AB/BC.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/271d5637c2a4a4fb88bb35aa0aa4f0a2a53024259e7885b9ae96be8f3abe7cba.png] 

⇒ Let AD = x cm, then DC = (14 − x) cm.

⇒ AD / DC = AB / BC

⇒ x / (14 − x) = 10 / 11

⇒ 11x = 10 × (14 − x)

⇒ 11x = 140 − 10x

⇒ 11x + 10x = 140

⇒ 21x = 140

⇒ x = 140 / 21

⇒ x = 20 / 3

**∴ The correct answer is 20/3 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Length of Internal Angle Bisector

The length of the angle bisector BD can be calculated using the formula: BD² = AB × BC − AD × DC.

External Angle Bisector Theorem

If the bisector of an external angle of a triangle intersects the extended opposite side at a point D', then AD' / CD' = AB / BC.

Incenter Property

The internal angle bisectors of a triangle are concurrent at a point called the incenter, which is equidistant from all sides.</p

questions.question: If the curved surface area of a solid cylinder is one-third of its total surface area, then what is the ratio of its diameter to its height?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Given: CSA / TSA = 1 / 3

Ratio of Height to (Height + Radius) ⇒ h / (h + r) = 1 / 3

Cross-multiplying: 3h = h + r ⇒ r = 2h

Diameter (d) = 2r = 2 × (2h) = 4h

Ratio of Diameter to Height = d : h = 4h : h = 4 : 1

**∴ The correct answer is 4 : 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given: Curved Surface Area (CSA) of a cylinder = (1/3) × Total Surface Area (TSA)

Formula for CSA = 2πrh

Formula for TSA = 2πr(h + r)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1fa961bf797100b0fca724bed7cb9baaf7d3cc1207bdcb1c32fbca0b309a58f2.png] 

According to the question:

⇒ 2πrh = (1/3) × 2πr(h + r)

⇒ h = (1/3) × (h + r)

⇒ 3h = h + r

⇒ r = 3h − h

⇒ r = 2h

We need to find the ratio of diameter (d) to height (h):

⇒ d = 2r

⇒ d = 2 × (2h) = 4h

⇒ d/h = 4/1

⇒ d : h = 4 : 1

**∴ The correct answer is 4 : 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Volume of Cylinder

The volume of a solid cylinder is given by V = πr²h, where r is the radius and h is the height.

Surface Areas of Cone

CSA of a cone = πrl and TSA of a cone = πr(l + r), where l is the slant height (√(r² + h²)).

Surface Area of Sphere

For a sphere, the CSA and TSA are the same, given by 4πr².</p

questions.question: The ratio of the incomes of A and B last year was 4 ∶ 3, respectively. The ratios of their individual incomes of the last year and the present year are 3 ∶ 4 and 5 ∶ 6, respectively. If their total income for the present year is Rs. 8.04 lakh, then the income of B last year was∶
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Ratio A : B (Last Year) = 4 : 3

A (Present) = 4 × (4 ÷ 3) = 16/3 | B (Present) = 3 × (6 ÷ 5) = 18/5

Ratio A : B (Present) = (16/3) : (18/5) = 80 : 54 = 40 : 27

Total units = 40 + 27 = 67 units → Rs. 8.04 lakh

1 unit = 0.12 lakh ⇒ B Last Year = (5 ÷ 6) × (27 × 0.12) = 2.7 lakh

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 2.7 lakh.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Ratio of incomes of A and B (Last Year) = 4 : 3

Individual ratio A (Last : Present) = 3 : 4

Individual ratio B (Last : Present) = 5 : 6

Total Present Income = Rs. 8.04 lakh

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/913849341f5d9505344dbb3568d22524a4133425cbe0888c83019841a2a3d5f1.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let last year incomes be AL = 4x and BL = 3x.

⇒ APᵣₑₛₑₙₜ = AL × (4 ÷ 3) = 4x × 4/3 = 16x/3

⇒ BPᵣₑₛₑₙₜ = BL × (6 ÷ 5) = 3x × 6/5 = 18x/5

⇒ Total Present Income = 16x/3 + 18x/5 = 8.04

⇒ (80x + 54x) ÷ 15 = 8.04

⇒ 134x ÷ 15 = 8.04

⇒ 134x = 8.04 × 15 = 120.6

⇒ x = 120.6 ÷ 134 = 0.9

⇒ Income of B last year = 3x = 3 × 0.9 = 2.7 lakh

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 2.7 lakh.**

**__Additional Information__**

Compounded Ratio

For two or more ratios, the compounded ratio is the ratio of the product of the antecedents to the product of the consequents (e.g., for a:b and c:d, it is ac:bd).

Inverse Ratio

The inverse ratio of a:b is b:a. It is often used in speed-time and work-efficiency problems.

Continued Proportion

Three quantities a, b, and c are in continued proportion if a:b = b:c, where b is the mean proportional (b² = ac).</p

questions.question: The speed of a boat in still water is 18 km/h and the speed of the current is 6 km/h. In how much time (in hours) will the boat travel a distance of 90 km upstream and the same distance downstream?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Downstream Speed (v + u) = 18 + 6 = 24 km/h

Upstream Speed (v − u) = 18 − 6 = 12 km/h

Total Time = (Distance ÷ Downstream Speed) + (Distance ÷ Upstream Speed)

Total Time = (90 ÷ 24) + (90 ÷ 12) = 3.75 + 7.5 = 11.25 hours

**∴ The correct answer is 11¼ hours.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Speed of boat (B) = 18 km/h

Speed of current (C) = 6 km/h

Distance (D) = 90 km

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/98561175f410925c994600bae653a514e1225f020214712d4bc73fc7a34f193e.png] 

**Formula Used:**

Time = Distance ÷ Speed

Downstream Speed = Speed of boat + Speed of current

Upstream Speed = Speed of boat − Speed of current

**Calculations:**

⇒ Downstream speed = 18 + 6 = 24 km/h

⇒ Upstream speed = 18 − 6 = 12 km/h

⇒ Time for downstream trip = 90 ÷ 24 = 3.75 hours

⇒ Time for upstream trip = 90 ÷ 12 = 7.5 hours

⇒ Total time = 3.75 + 7.5 = 11.25 hours

⇒ 11.25 hours = 11 + 0.25 = 11 + (1/4) = 11¼ hours

**∴ The correct answer is 11¼ hours.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Speed in Still Water

If downstream speed (D) and upstream speed (U) are known, Speed of boat = (D + U) ÷ 2.

Speed of Current

If downstream speed (D) and upstream speed (U) are known, Speed of current = (D − U) ÷ 2.

Average Speed for Round Trip

Average Speed = (Downstream Speed × Upstream Speed) ÷ Still Water Speed = (D × U) ÷ B.</p

questions.question: A person sells an article at 16% below its cost price. Had he sold it for Rs. 33 more, he would have gained 14%. To gain 25%, he should sell the article for∶
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Net difference in percentage = Gain % − Loss % = 14% − (−16%) = 30%.

Given that 30% of CP = Rs. 33.

Target SP to gain 25% = 125% of CP.

Value of 125% = (33 ÷ 30) × 125 = 1.1 × 125 = 137.5.

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 137.5.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Initial Loss = 16%

Potential Gain = 14%

Difference in Selling Price = Rs. 33

Target Gain = 25%

**Formula Used:**

SP = CP × (100 ± Profit/Loss %)/100

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0eb95bda70bc8f7a51e43d5c1e20d07ad0cdcba36edbc0145c6e007fb45947d4.png] 

**Calculations:**

Let the Cost Price (CP) be 100 units.

⇒ Initial Selling Price (SP₁) = 100 − 16 = 84 units

⇒ Second Selling Price (SP₂) = 100 + 14 = 114 units

⇒ Difference in SP = 114 − 84 = 30 units

⇒ According to question, 30 units = Rs. 33

⇒ 1 unit = 33 ÷ 30 = Rs. 1.1

⇒ Required Selling Price (to gain 25%) = 100 + 25 = 125 units

⇒ New Selling Price = 125 × 1.1 = Rs. 137.5

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 137.5.**

**__Additional Information__**

Profit and Loss Percentage

Profit or Loss is always calculated on the Cost Price (CP) unless stated otherwise. Profit % = (Profit/CP) × 100.

Marked Price and Discount

Discount is always allowed on the Marked Price (MP). SP = MP − Discount.

Relation between CP and MP

CP/MP = (100 − Discount%)/(100 + Profit%). This ratio is useful for solving complex markup and discount problems directly.</p

questions.question: The average weight of a certain number of students in a group is 72 kg. If 10 students having an average weight of 78kg leave and 4 students having an average weight of 80 kg join the group, the average weight of the students in the group decreases by 0.7 kg. The number of students initially in the group is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Initial average = 72 kg.

Net deviation from students leaving = 10 × (72 − 78) = −60 kg.

Net deviation from students joining = 4 × (80 − 72) = +32 kg.

Total net deviation = −60 + 32 = −28 kg.

New number of students = Net deviation ÷ Change in average = −28 ÷ (−0.7) = 40.

Initial number of students (n) = New count + 10 − 4 = 40 + 6 = 46.

**∴ The correct answer is 46 students.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Initial average = 72 kg | Students leaving = 10 (Avg 78 kg) | Students joining = 4 (Avg 80 kg) | New Average decrease = 0.7 kg.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fe98f442c4e5402b769629e7c41798c315fb0cb9623cf080b6c3b54f66bd11ec.png] 

Let the initial number of students be n.

⇒ Initial total weight = 72 × n

⇒ Weight of students who left = 10 × 78 = 780 kg

⇒ Weight of students who joined = 4 × 80 = 320 kg

⇒ Final number of students = n − 10 + 4 = n − 6

⇒ New Average = 72 − 0.7 = 71.3 kg

⇒ Final Total Weight = (n − 6) × 71.3

⇒ 72n − 780 + 320 = 71.3(n − 6)

⇒ 72n − 460 = 71.3n − 427.8

⇒ 72n − 71.3n = 460 − 427.8

⇒ 0.7n = 32.2

⇒ n = 32.2 ÷ 0.7 = 322 ÷ 7

⇒ n = 46

**∴ The correct answer is 46 students.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Deviation Method for Averages

Net Change in Average = (Total Deviation from Mean) ÷ (Total Number of Observations). If the net deviation is negative, the average decreases.

Average weight of a Group

When members leave or join, the new total weight = (Old Average × Old Count) − (Weight of Left) + (Weight of Joined).

Weighted Average Formula

Average꜀ₒₘbᵢₙₑd = (n₁x₁ + n₂x₂) ÷ (n₁ + n₂), where n is the number of items and x is their respective average.</p

questions.question: In a class, 83(1)/(3)\% of the number of students are girls and the rest are boys. If 60% of the number of boys and 80% of the number of girls are present, then what percentage of the total number of students in the class is absent?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

83 1/3% = 5/6. Let total students = 6 parts (Girls = 5, Boys = 1).

Absent Girls = 100% − 80% = 20% | Absent Boys = 100% − 60% = 40%.

Total absent parts = (5 × 20%) + (1 × 40%) = 100% + 40% = 140%.

Overall absent percentage = 140% ÷ 6 = 70/3% = 23 1/3%.

**∴ The correct answer is 23 1/3%.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Girls in class = 83 1/3% of total students

Present Boys = 60%, Present Girls = 80%

**Formula Used:**

Percentage = (Part / Total) × 100

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/49a5f217cb7eceab7d18446f5d9d8f2862f6974c4c2755d12f6fed70cd449144.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let total students = 600

⇒ Number of girls = 83 1/3% × 600 = (250/3)% × 600 = 500

⇒ Number of boys = 600 − 500 = 100

⇒ Absent boys = (100% − 60%) of 100 = 40% of 100 = 40

⇒ Absent girls = (100% − 80%) of 500 = 20% of 500 = 100

⇒ Total absent students = 40 + 100 = 140

⇒ Absent percentage = (140 / 600) × 100

⇒ Absent percentage = 140 / 6 = 70 / 3 = 23 1/3%

**∴ The correct answer is 23 1/3%.**

**__Additional Information__**

Percentage to Fraction Conversion

Standard fractions: 16 2/3% = 1/6, 33 1/3% = 1/3, 66 2/3% = 2/3, 83 1/3% = 5/6. Knowing these saves time in calculation.

Weighted Average Rule

Overall Average = (n₁ × x₁ + n₂ × x₂) ÷ (n₁ + n₂). Here, n represents ratios and x represents the absent percentages.

Base Value Choice

Always choose a base value (like 100 or 600) that is a multiple of the denominator of the given percentage fraction to avoid decimals.</p

questions.question: A sum lent out at simple interest amounts to Rs. 6076 in 1 year and Rs. 7504 in 3 years. The sum and the rate of interest (approx) p.a are respectively:
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Interest for 2 years (3 yr − 1 yr) = 7504 − 6076 = Rs. 1428

Interest for 1 year = 1428 ÷ 2 = Rs. 714

Principal (Sum) = Amount (1 yr) − Interest (1 yr) = 6076 − 714 = Rs. 5362

Rate % = (Interest ÷ Principal) × 100 = (714 ÷ 5362) × 100 ≈ 13.32%

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 5,362 and 13.32%.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Amount after 1 year (A₁) = Rs. 6076

Amount after 3 years (A₃) = Rs. 7504

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = Principal × Rate × Time ÷ 100

Amount (A) = Principal (P) + Simple Interest (SI)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3ae8c237442b06b6e36a6b5c1d21d18d7b6ae67c9998a78e5ec2a57cfd9e49ae.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ SI for 2 years (3 − 1 years) = A₃ − A₁

⇒ SI for 2 years = Rs. 7504 − Rs. 6076 = Rs. 1428

⇒ SI for 1 year = 1428 ÷ 2 = Rs. 714

⇒ Principal (Sum) = Amount after 1 year − SI for 1 year

⇒ Principal = 6076 − 714 = Rs. 5362

⇒ Rate of Interest (R) = (SI × 100) ÷ (P × T)

⇒ R = (714 × 100) ÷ (5362 × 1)

⇒ R ≈ 13.3159% → 13.32%

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 5,362 and 13.32%.**

**__Additional Information__**

Nature of Simple Interest

In Simple Interest, the interest earned remains constant every year because it is always calculated on the initial principal (P).

Amount and Principal Relation

Amount after T years is A = P + (P × R × T) ÷ 100. If we know the amounts at different years, the difference in amounts gives the interest for that specific time gap.

Effective Rate of Interest

For SI, the effective rate for T years is simply R × T. In Compound Interest, the effective rate is calculated using the formula [ (1 + R/100)T − 1 ] × 100.</p

questions.question: A sum of Rs. x is divided among A, B and C such that the ratio of the shares of A and B is 6 ∶ 7 and that of B and C is 3 ∶ 2. If the difference between the shares of A and C is Rs. 540, then the value of x is∶
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Combine ratios: A : B = 6 : 7 and B : C = 3 : 2.

A : B : C = (6 × 3) : (7 × 3) : (7 × 2) = 18 : 21 : 14.

Difference between A and C parts = 18 − 14 = 4 units.

Given 4 units = ₹540 → 1 unit = ₹135.

Total sum x = 18 + 21 + 14 = 53 units = 53 × 135 = ₹7155.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹7155.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Ratio A : B = 6 : 7 and B : C = 3 : 2. Difference between share of A and C = ₹540.

**Formula Used:** To combine ratios A : B and B : C, equate the value of the common term B.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/40fc66c85e5b7c0e51db5cc744a7d3a93028ad2441911edb10b9b4725938a202.png] 

⇒ Share of A : Share of B = 6 : 7

⇒ Share of B : Share of C = 3 : 2

⇒ To make B common, multiply first ratio by 3 and second ratio by 7:

⇒ A : B = (6 × 3) : (7 × 3) = 18 : 21

⇒ B : C = (3 × 7) : (2 × 7) = 21 : 14

⇒ A : B : C = 18 : 21 : 14

⇒ Difference between shares of A and C = 18 units − 14 units = 4 units

⇒ 4 units = ₹540

⇒ 1 unit = ₹540 ÷ 4 = ₹135

⇒ Total sum x = (18 + 21 + 14) units = 53 units

⇒ x = 53 × ₹135 = ₹7155

**∴ The correct answer is ₹7155.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Combining Ratios

If A : B = a : b and B : C = c : d, then A : B : C = (a × c) : (b × c) : (b × d).

Compound Ratio

The compound ratio of (a : b) and (c : d) is (ac : bd), which is the product of the individual ratios.

Proportional Division

If a sum S is divided into parts A, B, and C in the ratio p : q : r, then Share of A = S × p / (p + q + r).

questions.question: A, B and C invested their capitals in the ratio of 2 : 3 : 5 The ratio of months for which A, B and C invested is 4 : 2 : 3. If C gets a share of profit which Is Rs. 1,47,000 more than that of A, then B’s share of profit is:

Profit Ratio A : B : C = (2 × 4) : (3 × 2) : (5 × 3) = 8 : 6 : 15

Difference between C and A = 15 − 8 = 7 units

Given, 7 units = ₹1,47,000 → 1 unit = ₹21,000

questions.question: A circle is inscribed in quadrilateral ABCD touching AB, BC, CD and AD at the points P, Q, R and S, respectively, and ∠B = 90°. If AD = 24 cm, AB = 27 cm and DR = 6 cm, then what is the circumference of the circle?
questions.solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__ Tangents from an external point are equal: DR = DS = 6 cm. AS = AD − DS = 24 − 6 = 18 cm, and AP = AS = 18 cm. PB = AB − AP = 27 − 18 = 9 cm. Since angle B = 90⁰, the radius r of the inscribed circle is equal to PB = 9 cm. Circumference = 2 × π × r = 2 × π × 9 = 18π. **∴ The correct answer is 18π cm.**

questions.question: ΔABC and ΔDBC are on the same base BC but on opposite sides of it. AD and BC intersect each other perpendicularly at O. If AO = a cm, DO = b cm and the area of ΔABC = x cm², then what is the area (in cm²) of ΔDBC?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

For triangles sharing the same base, the ratio of their areas is equal to the ratio of their heights.

Area(ΔABC) ÷ Area(ΔDBC) = Height(AO) ÷ Height(DO)

x ÷ Area(ΔDBC) = a ÷ b

Area(ΔDBC) = (b ÷ a) × x = bx/a

**∴ The correct answer is bx/a cm².**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** AO = a cm, DO = b cm, Area(ΔABC) = x cm². AD ⊥ BC at O.

**Formula Used:** Area of triangle = 1/2 × base × height.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/680c95deb6e14c87910220e0d236692982e5ff6e2ae82ec49bdb0133ce88ffe2.png] 

⇒ Area(ΔABC) = 1/2 × BC × AO

⇒ x = 1/2 × BC × a

⇒ BC = 2x / a

⇒ Area(ΔDBC) = 1/2 × BC × DO

⇒ Area(ΔDBC) = 1/2 × (2x / a) × b

⇒ Area(ΔDBC) = (x × b) / a

⇒ Area(ΔDBC) = bx/a

**∴ The correct answer is bx/a cm².**

**__Additional Information__**

Triangle Area Ratios

If two triangles have the same base, the ratio of their areas is equal to the ratio of their altitudes: Area₁/Area₂ = h₁/h₂.

Triangles between Parallels

Two triangles having the same base and lying between the same parallel lines have equal areas.

Median Property

A median of a triangle divides it into two triangles of equal area because they share the same height and have equal bases.</p

questions.question: If x = frac{{sqrt 5 - sqrt 3 }}{{sqrt 5 + sqrt 3 }} and y is the reciprocal of x, then what is the value of (x³ + y³)?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

If x = (√a − √b) / (√a + √b) and y = 1/x, then x + y = 2(a + b) / (a − b).

Substituting a = 5 and b = 3: x + y = 2(5 + 3) / (5 − 3) = 2 × 8 / 2 = 8.

Since y is the reciprocal of x, xy = 1.

Value of x³ + y³ = (x + y)³ − 3xy(x + y) = 8³ − 3(1)(8).

Final Result = 512 − 24 = 488.

**∴ The correct answer is 488.**

**__Alternate Method__**

Given: x = (√5 − √3) / (√5 + √3) and y = 1/x

Formula: x³ + y³ = (x + y)³ − 3xy(x + y)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1fc677ec6a6ed2275a4a04630e511885b79dd6c968d7b5dd526759455d540345.png] 

⇒ Rationalizing x: x = [(√5 − √3) × (√5 − √3)] / [(√5 + √3) × (√5 − √3)]

⇒ x = (5 + 3 − 2√15) / (5 − 3) = (8 − 2√15) / 2 = 4 − √15

⇒ Similarly, y = 1/x = 4 + √15

⇒ x + y = (4 − √15) + (4 + √15) = 8

⇒ xy = (4 − √15)(4 + √15) = 16 − 15 = 1

⇒ x³ + y³ = 8³ − 3 × 1 × 8

⇒ x³ + y³ = 512 − 24 = 488

**∴ The correct answer is 488.**

**__Additional Information__**

Algebraic Identity for Cubes

The sum of cubes is given by a³ + b³ = (a + b)(a² − ab + b²) or a³ + b³ = (a + b)³ − 3ab(a + b).

Rationalizing the Denominator

To rationalize a denominator like (√a + √b), multiply both numerator and denominator by its conjugate (√a − √b).

Reciprocal Sum Property

If x = a − √b and y = a + √b where a² − b = 1, then x and y are reciprocals (xy = 1).</p

questions.question: If 8x³ – 27y³ = (Ax + By) (Cx² – Dy² + 6xy), then what is the value of (A + B + C – D)?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Identify the identity: a³ − b³ = (a − b)(a² + ab + b²)

Here, (2x)³ − (3y)³ = (2x − 3y)(4x² + 6xy + 9y²)

Comparing coefficients: A = 2, B = −3, C = 4, −D = 9 ⇒ D = −9

Required value: A + B + C − D = 2 − 3 + 4 − (−9) = 12

**∴ The correct answer is 12.**

**__Alternate Method__**

Given Equation: 8x³ − 27y³ = (Ax + By) (Cx² − Dy² + 6xy)

Formula Used: a³ − b³ = (a − b)(a² + ab + b²)

⇒ 8x³ − 27y³ = (2x)³ − (3y)³

⇒ (2x − 3y) ((2x)² + (2x)(3y) + (3y)²)

⇒ (2x − 3y) (4x² + 6xy + 9y²)

Now, comparing this with the given RHS: (Ax + By) (Cx² − Dy² + 6xy)

⇒ Ax + By = 2x − 3y ⇒ A = 2, B = −3

⇒ Cx² − Dy² + 6xy = 4x² + 9y² + 6xy

⇒ C = 4 and −D = 9 ⇒ D = −9

⇒ Value of (A + B + C − D) = 2 + (−3) + 4 − (−9)

⇒ 2 − 3 + 4 + 9 = 12

**∴ The correct answer is 12.**

**__Additional Information__**

Sum of Cubes Identity

The identity for the sum of two cubes is a³ + b³ = (a + b)(a² − ab + b²).

Whole Cube Expansion

(a − b)³ = a³ − b³ − 3ab(a − b), which is different from the difference of two cubes identity.

Coefficient Comparison

When two algebraic expressions are identical for all values of variables, the coefficients of corresponding terms (like x, y, x², xy) must be equal.</p

questions.question: What is the ratio of the third proportional to 0.4 and 0.8, to the mean proportional between 13.5 and 0.24?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Third proportional of a and b = b² ÷ a

⇒ Third proportional (P₁) = (0.8 × 0.8) ÷ 0.4 = 0.64 ÷ 0.4 = 1.6

Mean proportional of x and y = √(x × y)

⇒ Mean proportional (P₂) = √(13.5 × 0.24) = √3.24 = 1.8

Required Ratio = 1.6 : 1.8 = 16 : 18 = 8 : 9

**∴ The correct answer is 8 : 9.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Numbers for third proportional: a = 0.4, b = 0.8

Numbers for mean proportional: x = 13.5, y = 0.24

**Formula Used:**

Third Proportional (c) of a and b is given by a : b = b : c ⇒ c = b²/a

Mean Proportional (m) of x and y is given by x : m = m : y ⇒ m = √(xy)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/81a3053acd914c4b3d01a6f6b78c9b94d7b2cf8fe9bb188118f8a211b8b24270.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the third proportional be P₁.

⇒ P₁ = (0.8 × 0.8) ÷ 0.4

⇒ P₁ = 0.64 ÷ 0.4 = 1.6

⇒ Let the mean proportional be P₂.

⇒ P₂ = √(13.5 × 0.24)

⇒ P₂ = √(3.24)

⇒ P₂ = 1.8

⇒ Required Ratio = P₁ : P₂

⇒ Required Ratio = 1.6 : 1.8

⇒ Multiply both by 10: 16 : 18

⇒ Divide both by 2: 8 : 9

**∴ The correct answer is 8 : 9.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Mean Proportional

For two numbers a and b, the mean proportional x satisfies a : x = x : b, giving x = √(ab).

Third Proportional

For two numbers a and b, the third proportional c satisfies a : b = b : c, giving c = b²/a.

Fourth Proportional

For three numbers a, b, and c, the fourth proportional d satisfies a : b = c : d, giving d = (b × c)/a.

Continued Proportion

Three quantities a, b, c are in continued proportion if a : b = b : c, which implies b² = ac.</p

questions.question: A, B and C start a business. A invests 33(1)/(3)\% of the total capital, B invests 25% of the remaining and C invests the rest. If the total profit at the end of a year is Rs. 1,62,000 then A’s share in profit is:
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

A's investment is 33 1/3% (or 1/3) of the total capital.

Since the time period for all partners is the same, the profit sharing ratio is identical to the investment ratio.

A's share of profit = 33 1/3% of total profit → (1/3) × 1,62,000.

A's share = Rs. 54,000.

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 54,000.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total Profit = Rs. 1,62,000

A's investment = 33 1/3% of total capital

B's investment = 25% of the remaining capital

**Formula Used:**

Profit Share = Investment × Time period

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d28077266170ebb97085f1722ba622c89616005bcfb0b4a912b52bb46b77955f.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let total capital = 1 unit

⇒ A's investment = 33 1/3% = 1/3

⇒ Remaining capital = 1 − 1/3 = 2/3

⇒ B's investment = 25% of 2/3 = 1/4 × 2/3 = 1/6

⇒ C's investment = 2/3 − 1/6 = (4 − 1)/6 = 3/6 = 1/2

⇒ Investment ratio A : B : C = 1/3 : 1/6 : 1/2 = 2 : 1 : 3

⇒ Total ratio parts = 2 + 1 + 3 = 6 units

⇒ 6 units = Rs. 1,62,000

⇒ 1 unit = 1,62,000 ÷ 6 = Rs. 27,000

⇒ A's share (2 units) = 2 × 27,000 = Rs. 54,000

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 54,000.**

**__Additional Information__**

Profit Sharing Rule

In any partnership, if the time period of investment is the same for all partners, the profit is distributed in the ratio of their capitals: P₁ : P₂ = C₁ : C₂.

Compound Partnership

If partners invest for different time periods, the profit is divided in the ratio of the product of capital and time: P₁ : P₂ = (C₁ × T₁) : (C₂ × T₂).

Active and Sleeping Partners

An active partner manages the business and may receive a salary or fixed percentage of profit before the remaining profit is distributed among all partners in their investment ratio.</p

questions.question: The point of intersection of the graphs of the equation 3x – 5y = 19 and 3y – 7x + 1 = 0 is P(α, β). What is the value of (3α – β)?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Solve equations: 3α − 5β = 19 and −7α + 3β = −1

Multiply Eq(1) × 3 ⇒ 9α − 15β = 57

Multiply Eq(2) × 5 ⇒ −35α + 15β = −5

Adding both: −26α = 52 ⇒ α = −2

Substitute α = −2 in Eq(1): 3(−2) − 5β = 19 ⇒ −5β = 25 ⇒ β = −5

Required: 3α − β = 3(−2) − (−5) = −6 + 5 = −1

**∴ The correct answer is -1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given Equations:

Line 1: 3x − 5y = 19 ... (i)

Line 2: 3y − 7x + 1 = 0 ⇒ −7x + 3y = −1 ... (ii)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/efda5fc3c94bfd9a876afd36759f3d556568b180028d697af225f3a20146de4e.png] 

To find the point of intersection P(α, β), solve (i) and (ii) simultaneously:

⇒ Multiply (i) by 3: 9x − 15y = 57

⇒ Multiply (ii) by 5: −35x + 15y = −5

⇒ Add the two resulting equations:

⇒ (9x − 35x) + (−15y + 15y) = 57 − 5

⇒ −26x = 52

⇒ x = 52 ÷ (−26) = −2

⇒ ∴ α = −2

⇒ Substitute x = −2 in (i):

⇒ 3(−2) − 5y = 19

⇒ −6 − 5y = 19

⇒ −5y = 19 + 6 = 25

⇒ y = 25 ÷ (−5) = −5

⇒ ∴ β = −5

⇒ Now, calculate the value of (3α − β):

⇒ 3(−2) − (−5)

⇒ −6 + 5 = −1

**∴ The correct answer is -1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Condition for Unique Solution

For a system of two linear equations a₁x + b₁y = c₁ and a₂x + b₂y = c₂, a unique solution exists if a₁/a₂ ≠ b₁/b₂.

Cramer's Rule

Linear equations can be solved using determinants where x = Dₓ/D and y = Dy/D, provided the main determinant D ≠ 0.

Consistency of Equations

A system is called consistent if it has at least one solution (intersecting or coincident lines) and inconsistent if it has no solution (parallel lines).</p

questions.question: If x⁴ – 83x² + 1 = 0, then a value of x³ – x⁻³ can be:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Divide the equation x⁴ − 83x² + 1 = 0 by x² to get x² + 1/x² = 83.

Find x − 1/x using the relation: x − 1/x = √(x² + 1/x² − 2) = √(83 − 2) = 9.

Using the cube shortcut: If x − 1/x = k, then x³ − 1/x³ = k³ + 3k.

Putting k = 9: x³ − 1/x³ = 9³ + 3(9) = 729 + 27 = 756.

**∴ The correct answer is 756.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given: x⁴ − 83x² + 1 = 0

Formula Used: (a − b)³ = a³ − b³ − 3ab(a − b)

⇒ x⁴ − 83x² + 1 = 0

⇒ (x⁴ + 1) / x² = 83x² / x²

⇒ x² + 1/x² = 83

⇒ (x − 1/x)² + 2 = 83

⇒ (x − 1/x)² = 81

⇒ x − 1/x = 9

⇒ (x − 1/x)³ = x³ − 1/x³ − 3(x)(1/x)(x − 1/x)

⇒ 9³ = x³ − 1/x³ − 3(9)

⇒ 729 = x³ − 1/x³ − 27

⇒ x³ − 1/x³ = 729 + 27

⇒ x³ − 1/x³ = 756

**∴ The correct answer is 756.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Reciprocal Identities for Squares

If x + 1/x = k, then x² + 1/x² = k² − 2. Conversely, if x − 1/x = k, then x² + 1/x² = k² + 2.

Reciprocal Identities for Cubes

If x + 1/x = k, then x³ + 1/x³ = k³ − 3k. If x − 1/x = k, then x³ − 1/x³ = k³ + 3k.

Higher Power Reductions

Equations of the form ax⁴ + bx² + a = 0 are symmetric and can be solved by dividing the entire equation by x² to create reciprocal terms.</p

questions.question: If the 11-digit number 5678x43267y is divisible by 72, then the value of √(5x + 8y) is
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

For a number to be divisible by 72, it must be divisible by its coprime factors 8 and 9.

Divisibility by 8: Last three digits 67y ÷ 8 ⇒ 672 ÷ 8 = 84, so y = 2.

Divisibility by 9: Sum of digits (5+6+7+8+x+4+3+2+6+7+y) = 48 + x + y must be divisible by 9.

For y = 2, sum = 50 + x ⇒ Nearest multiple of 9 is 54, so x = 4.

Required value = √(5 × 4 + 8 × 2) = √(20 + 16) = √36 = 6.

**∴ The correct answer is 6.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Number: 5678x43267y

Divisibility: Divisible by 72

**Formula Used:**

Divisibility Rule of 8: Last three digits of the number must be divisible by 8.

Divisibility Rule of 9: Sum of all digits must be divisible by 9.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/43e0384d7f2cf243db528bd0d0a6d88eb066383ad91ede41298ed495b2709bcf.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Divisibility by 8: Last three digits = 67y

⇒ 67y ÷ 8 ⇒ 672 ÷ 8 = 84 (Exact division)

⇒ Therefore, y = 2

⇒ Divisibility by 9: Sum of digits = 5+6+7+8+x+4+3+2+6+7+2

⇒ Sum = 50 + x

⇒ For (50 + x) to be divisible by 9, the next multiple is 54

⇒ x = 54 − 50 = 4

⇒ Value to find = √(5x + 8y)

⇒ √(5 × 4 + 8 × 2) = √(20 + 16)

⇒ √36 = 6

**∴ The correct answer is 6.**

**__Additional Information__**

Divisibility by 72

A number is divisible by 72 if and only if it is divisible by both 8 and 9, as 8 and 9 are coprime factors (HCF = 1).

Divisibility by 11

The difference between the sum of digits at odd places and the sum of digits at even places must be 0 or a multiple of 11.

Coprime Factor Rule

If a number N is divisible by two coprime numbers a and b, then N is also divisible by the product a × b.</p

questions.question: A hemispherical bowl of internal diameter 36 cm is full of a liquid. This liquid is to be filled into cylindrical bottles each of radius 3 cm and height 12 cm. How many such bottles are required to empty the bowl?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Volume ratio method: Number of bottles (n) = Volume of bowl ÷ Volume of bottle

n = [(2/3) × R³] ÷ [r² × h] (where π cancels out)

n = (2 × 18 × 18 × 18) ÷ (3 × 3 × 3 × 12)

n = (2 × 6 × 6 × 1.5) × 1.5? Let us simplify: n = (2 × 5832) ÷ (3 × 9 × 12) = 11664 ÷ 324 = 36

**∴ The correct answer is 36 bottles.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Diameter of bowl = 36 cm ⇒ Radius (R) = 18 cm

Radius of bottle (r) = 3 cm

Height of bottle (h) = 12 cm

**Formula Used:**

Volume of hemispherical bowl = (2/3)πR³

Volume of cylindrical bottle = πr²h

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e37afdcb116b38eb3e9d1984dfda9779c7124117e17a5c6d6b9bdd4c019fdcb0.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Volume of liquid in bowl = (2/3) × π × (18)³

⇒ Volume of liquid in bowl = (2/3) × π × 5832 = 3888π cm³

⇒ Volume of one bottle = π × (3)² × 12

⇒ Volume of one bottle = π × 9 × 12 = 108π cm³

⇒ Number of bottles (n) = (3888π) ÷ (108π)

⇒ n = 3888 ÷ 108

⇒ n = 36

**∴ The correct answer is 36 bottles.**

**__Additional Information__**

Volume of Sphere

The volume of a complete sphere is given by (4/3)πr³, which is exactly double the volume of a hemisphere of the same radius.

Surface Area of Hemisphere

Curved Surface Area (CSA) = 2πr² and Total Surface Area (TSA) = 3πr² (including the circular base).

Conservation of Volume

When a liquid is transferred from one container to multiple smaller containers, the total volume remains constant: Vₜₒₜₐₗ = n × Vₛₘₐₗₗ.</p

questions.question: In a circle with centre O, AC and BD are two chords. AC and BD meet at E when produced. If AB is the diameter and ∠AEB = 68°, then the measure of ∠DOC is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For a circle where diameter AB and chords AC and BD (produced) meet at E:

Direct Formula: ∠DOC = 180° − 2 × ∠AEB

Given: ∠AEB = 68°

∠DOC = 180° − 2 × 68°

∠DOC = 180° − 136° = 44°

**∴ The correct answer is 44°.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** AB is the diameter, O is the center, ∠AEB = 68°.

**Formula Used:** Angle in a semicircle is 90°; Angle at the center is twice the angle at the circumference.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7aa7cba9848965f0c0887571081d3747138233036ec6a99465d44c972fce4ecc.png] 

⇒ Join BC. Since AB is the diameter, ∠ACB = 90° (Angle in a semicircle).

⇒ In ΔBCE, ∠BCE = 180° − ∠ACB = 180° − 90° = 90°.

⇒ In ΔBCE, ∠CBE + ∠BCE + ∠CEB = 180°.

⇒ ∠CBE + 90° + 68° = 180°.

⇒ ∠CBE = 180° − 158° = 22°.

⇒ Since ∠CBE is the same as ∠DBC, ∠DBC = 22°.

⇒ The angle subtended by arc DC at the center O is ∠DOC.

⇒ ∠DOC = 2 × ∠DBC = 2 × 22°.

⇒ ∠DOC = 44°.

**∴ The correct answer is 44°.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Angle in a Semicircle

Any angle subtended by the diameter at the circumference of the circle is always 90°.

Central Angle Theorem

The angle subtended by an arc at the center is double the angle subtended by it at any point on the remaining part of the circle.

External Intersection of Chords

If two chords AC and BD intersect at point E outside the circle, then ∠AEB = 1/2 × (major arc − minor arc).</p

questions.question: Let x be the least number which when divided by 15, 18, 20 and 27, the remainder in each case is 10 and x is a multiple of 31. What least number should be added to x to make it a perfect square?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

LCM(15, 18, 20, 27) = 540.

x = 540k + 10 must be divisible by 31.

Testing k: (13k + 10) ÷ 31 ⇒ 13(4) + 10 = 62, which is 31 × 2.

x = 540 × 4 + 10 = 2170.

Next perfect square after 2170 is 47² = 2209.

Number to be added = 2209 − 2170 = 39.

**∴ The correct answer is 39.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Divisors are 15, 18, 20, 27 with remainder 10. x is a multiple of 31.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0971c7fc24e0044a9dc215eada4eae41f340b49971d602c5ebff6cf5cd055e60.png] 

**Step 1: Find LCM of 15, 18, 20, and 27.**

⇒ 15 = 3 × 5

⇒ 18 = 2 × 3²

⇒ 20 = 2² × 5

⇒ 27 = 3³

⇒ LCM = 2² × 3³ × 5 = 4 × 27 × 5 = 540

**Step 2: Find the least multiple of 31 in the form 540k + 10.**

⇒ (540k + 10) ÷ 31

⇒ (31 × 17k + 13k + 10) ÷ 31

⇒ 13k + 10 should be a multiple of 31.

⇒ For k = 4: 13 × 4 + 10 = 52 + 10 = 62 (Divisible by 31)

questions.question: If x = (164)¹⁶⁹ + (333)³³⁷ – (727)⁷²⁶, then what is the units digit of x?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Units digit of 4odd power is always 4.

Units digit of 3³³⁷ → 337 ÷ 4 gives remainder 1 → 3¹ = 3.

Units digit of 7⁷²⁶ → 726 ÷ 4 gives remainder 2 → 7² = 49 → 9.

Expression units digit = 4 + 3 − 9 = −2.

Since the digit cannot be negative, add 10 → 10 − 2 = 8.

**∴ The correct answer is 8.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given: x = (164)¹⁶⁹ + (333)³³⁷ − (727)⁷²⁶

To find the units digit of x, we calculate the units digit of each term individually:

⇒ Term 1: (164)¹⁶⁹ → last digit of base is 4. Power 169 is odd. 4odd always ends in 4.

⇒ Term 2: (333)³³⁷ → last digit of base is 3. Divide power 337 by 4 → 337 = (4 × 84) + 1. Remainder = 1. Units digit = 3¹ = 3.

⇒ Term 3: (727)⁷²⁶ → last digit of base is 7. Divide power 726 by 4 → 726 = (4 × 181) + 2. Remainder = 2. Units digit = 7² = 49 → 9.

⇒ Units digit of x = (Units digit of Term 1) + (Units digit of Term 2) − (Units digit of Term 3)

⇒ Units digit of x = 4 + 3 − 9

⇒ Units digit of x = 7 − 9 = −2

⇒ If the result is negative, add 10: −2 + 10 = 8.

**∴ The correct answer is 8.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Cyclicity of Digits

The digits 2, 3, 7, and 8 follow a cycle of 4. For any power n, the units digit is the same as the base raised to (n mod 4). If the remainder is 0, use 4 as the power.

Parity Rule for 4 and 9

For base 4: 4odd ends in 4 and 4eveⁿ ends in 6. For base 9: 9odd ends in 9 and 9eveⁿ ends in 1.

Handling Negative Results

In units digit arithmetic, if the subtraction results in a negative value, add 10 to obtain the correct positive units digit representing the borrow from the tens place.</p

questions.question: Pipes A and B can fill a tank in 16 hours and 24 hours, respectively, and pipe C alone can empty the full tank in x hours. All the pipes were opened together at 10:30 AM, but C was closed at 2:30 PM. If the tank was full at 8:30 PM on the same day, then what is the value of x?

questions.question: If the price of petrol increases by 19% and Sunitha intends to spend only an additional 12% on petrol, by what percent should she reduce the quantity of petrol purchased (nearest to an integer)?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Let the initial expenditure be 100.

New Price = 100 + 19 = 119; Target Expenditure = 100 + 12 = 112.

Quantity reduction % = (New Price − Target Expenditure) ÷ New Price × 100

⇒ (119 − 112) ÷ 119 × 100 = 700 ÷ 119 ≈ 5.88%.

**∴ The correct answer is 6%.**

**__Alternate Method__**

Given: Price increase = 19%, Intended expenditure increase = 12%

Formula: Expenditure = Price × Quantity

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7dd2798d249286f79fa8d340af9f0ba20939dcbdf97f08f5e7c7bcada06e5890.png] 

⇒ Let original Price = 100 and original Quantity = 100.

⇒ Original Expenditure = 100 × 100 = 10,000.

⇒ New Price = 100 + 19 = 119.

⇒ New Expenditure = 10,000 + 12% of 10,000 = 11,200.

⇒ New Quantity = 11,200 ÷ 119 ≈ 94.117.

⇒ Percentage reduction in quantity = 100 − 94.117 = 5.883%.

⇒ Nearest integer = 6%.

**∴ The correct answer is 6%.**

**__Additional Information__**

Price-Consumption-Expenditure Rule

When the price of a commodity increases by P% and the expenditure increases by E%, the new consumption is (100+E)/(100+P) of the original consumption.

Constant Expenditure Case

If the expenditure remains constant (0% increase), the percentage reduction in consumption is given by [r/(100+r)] × 100, where r is the percentage increase in price.

Successive Percentage Formula

Net % change in expenditure can also be calculated as [a + b + (ab/100)]%, where a is % change in price and b is % change in consumption.</p

questions.question: When a two-digit number is multiplied by the sum of its digits, the product is 424. When the number obtained by interchanging its digits is multiplied by the sum of the digits, the result is 280. The sum of the digits of the given number is:
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**8**__
**__Key Points__**
__

• Let the **two-digit number** be represented as **10x + y**, where **x** is the **tens digit** and **y** is the **units digit**.

• The **sum of the digits** is **(x + y)**.

• According to the first condition: When the number is multiplied by the sum of its digits, the product is **424**.

**(10x + y)(x + y) = 424** −−− (Equation 1)

• The number obtained by **interchanging its digits** is **10y + x**.

• According to the second condition: When this new number is multiplied by the sum of the digits, the result is **280**.

**(10y + x)(x + y) = 280** −−− (Equation 2)

• To find the **sum of the digits**, add Equation 1 and Equation 2:

**(10x + y)(x + y) + (10y + x)(x + y) = 424 + 280**

**(x + y) [(10x + y) + (10y + x)] = 704**

**(x + y) [11x + 11y] = 704**

**(x + y) * 11(x + y) = 704**

• Simplify the equation:

**11(x + y)² = 704**

**(x + y)² = 704 ÷ 11**

**(x + y)² = 64**

• Taking the **square root** of both sides:

**x + y = √64**

**x + y = 8**

• The **sum of the digits** of the given number is **8**. Therefore, **Option 4** is the correct answer.

**Additional Information__**

• A **two-digit number** can always be expressed in the form **10t + u**, where **t** is the tens place and **u** is the units place.

• If we need to find the specific number in this problem:

We know **x + y = 8**.

From Equation 1: **(10x + y)(8) = 424**, which means **10x + y = 53**.

By comparing, the **tens digit x = 5** and the **units digit y = 3**.

The original number is **53**, and the interchanged number is **35**.

• Check: **35 * 8 = 280**, which matches the second condition given in the question.

• The **sum of digits** (5 + 3) is **8**.

questions.question: If sqrt {10 - 2sqrt {21} } + sqrt {8 + 2sqrt {15} } = sqrt a + sqrt b , where a and b are positive integers, then the value of √(ab) is closet to:

[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Break the surds using the rule: √(x ± 2√y) = √m ± √n where m+n=x and m×n=y.

√(10 − 2√21) = √7 − √3 (since 7+3=10 and 7×3=21)

√(8 + 2√15) = √5 + √3 (since 5+3=8 and 5×3=15)

Sum = (√7 − √3) + (√5 + √3) = √7 + √5

Comparing with √a + √b, we get a = 7 and b = 5.

√(ab) = √(7 × 5) = √35 ≈ 5.9

**∴ The correct answer is 5.9.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given Expression: √(10 − 2√21) + √(8 + 2√15) = √a + √b

Step 1: Simplify √(10 − 2√21)

⇒ √(10 − 2√21) = √[7 + 3 − 2√(7 × 3)]

⇒ √[(√7)² + (√3)² − 2√7√3]

⇒ √[(√7 − √3)²] = √7 − √3

Step 2: Simplify √(8 + 2√15)

⇒ √(8 + 2√15) = √[5 + 3 + 2√(5 × 3)]

⇒ √[(√5)² + (√3)² + 2√5√3]

⇒ √[(√5 + √3)²] = √5 + √3

Step 3: Combine the simplified terms

⇒ (√7 − √3) + (√5 + √3) = √7 + √5

⇒ √a + √b = √7 + √5

⇒ a = 7, b = 5 (as a and b are positive integers)

Step 4: Calculate √(ab)

⇒ √(ab) = √(7 × 5) = √35

⇒ Since 5.9² = 34.81 and 6.0² = 36

⇒ √35 ≈ 5.916

**∴ The correct answer is 5.9.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Square Root of a Surd

A surd of the form √(x ± 2√y) can be simplified to √m ± √n only when x = m + n and y = mn. This is based on the identity (a ± b)² = a² + b² ± 2ab.

Root Approximations

Common square root values helpful in exams: √2 ≈ 1.414, √3 ≈ 1.732, √5 ≈ 2.236, √6 ≈ 2.449, √7 ≈ 2.645.

Comparing Surds

To compare √a + √b with √c + √d, if a+b = c+d, the one with the larger product ab is larger.</p

questions.question: Sujata marks an article 36% above the cost price and allows a 40% discount on the marked price. The loss percentage is∶

Successive percentage change formula: Net % = a + b + (a × b)/100

Here, markup percentage (a) = +36% and discount percentage (b) = −40%

Net change = 36 − 40 + (36 × −40)/100

Net change = −4 − 14.4 = −18.4%

Negative sign indicates a loss of 18.4%.

**∴ The correct answer is 18.4%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Markup % = 36%

Discount % = 40%

**Formula Used:**

Marked Price (MP) = CP × (100 + Markup%)/100

Selling Price (SP) = MP × (100 − Discount%)/100

Loss % = [(CP − SP) / CP] × 100

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3b42148e89549216250a3c2cc8b32e4c19e3577a652473a0077abfefb585cb9e.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let Cost Price (CP) = 100

⇒ Marked Price (MP) = 100 + 36% of 100 = 136

⇒ Discount = 40% of 136 = (40 ÷ 100) × 136 = 54.4

⇒ Selling Price (SP) = 136 − 54.4 = 81.6

⇒ Loss = CP − SP = 100 − 81.6 = 18.4

⇒ Loss Percentage = (Loss / CP) × 100

⇒ Loss Percentage = (18.4 / 100) × 100 = 18.4%

**∴ The correct answer is 18.4%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Marked Price and Markup

Marked price is the price displayed on the product. Markup % = [(MP − CP) / CP] × 100.

Successive Percentage Rule

When a value is changed by x% and then by y%, the net change is [x + y + (xy/100)]%.

Profit and Loss Relation

Profit occurs when SP > CP, and Loss occurs when CP > SP. Both are always calculated on CP unless stated otherwise.</p

questions.question: Two-third of the number of employees of a company are males and the rest are females. If 3/8 of the male employees and 2/5 of the female employees are temporary employees and the total number of permanent employees is 740, then 7/15 of the total number of employees exceeds the number of temporary female employees by:
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Assume Total Employees = 120 units (LCM of 3, 8, 5, 15).

Males = 2/3 × 120 = 80 units; Females = 1/3 × 120 = 40 units.

Permanent: Male = 5/8 × 80 = 50; Female = 3/5 × 40 = 24. Total = 74 units.

Given 74 units = 740 ⇒ 1 unit = 10.

Requirement: (7/15 × 120) − (Temp Female: 2/5 × 40) = 56 − 16 = 40 units.

**∴ The correct answer is 400.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Ratio of Male to Female = 2 : 1

Temporary Male = 3/8 of total males | Temporary Female = 2/5 of total females

Total Permanent employees = 740

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/212d81d6605aa28fcf22979b0a94f6e9eea8ad8c410a0ee1984cf94a43037906.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let total employees = 120x

⇒ Males = 2/3 × 120x = 80x; Females = 1/3 × 120x = 40x

⇒ Permanent Males = (1 − 3/8) × 80x = 5/8 × 80x = 50x

⇒ Permanent Females = (1 − 2/5) × 40x = 3/5 × 40x = 24x

⇒ Total Permanent = 50x + 24x = 74x = 740 ⇒ x = 10

⇒ Total employees = 120 × 10 = 1200

⇒ 7/15 of total = 7/15 × 1200 = 560

⇒ Temporary females = 2/5 × (40 × 10) = 2/5 × 400 = 160

⇒ Difference = 560 − 160 = 400

**∴ The correct answer is 400.**

**__Additional Information__**

Fractional Parts and Ratios

When multiple fractions like 2/3, 3/8, and 2/5 are involved, assuming the total as the LCM of denominators (3, 8, 5) simplifies the calculation by avoiding decimals.

Complementary Fractions

If x/y are temporary, then (1 − x/y) are permanent. For example, if 3/8 are temporary, then 5/8 are permanent.

Base of Percentage/Fraction

Always identify the base: 3/8 is of males, whereas 7/15 is of the total employees. Multiplying a fraction by the wrong base is a common error.</p

questions.question: If x + (1)/({16x)} = 3, then the value of 16{x³} + (1)/({256{x³)}} is∶
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Multiply the given equation by 4 to get 4x + 1/(4x) = 12.

Use the standard algebraic identity: If a + 1/a = n, then a³ + 1/a³ = n³ − 3n.

Substituting n = 12, we get 64x³ + 1/64x³ = 12³ − 3(12) = 1728 − 36 = 1692.

The required expression 16x³ + 1/256x³ is exactly 1/4 of (64x³ + 1/64x³).

Value = 1692 ÷ 4 = 423.

**∴ The correct answer is 423.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given: x + 1/16x = 3

To find: 16x³ + 1/256x³

Formula used: (a + b)³ = a³ + b³ + 3ab(a + b)

⇒ x + 1/16x = 3

Multiplying both sides by 4:

⇒ 4(x + 1/16x) = 4 × 3

⇒ 4x + 1/4x = 12

Now, cubing both sides of the equation:

⇒ (4x + 1/4x)³ = 12³

⇒ (4x)³ + (1/4x)³ + 3 × 4x × (1/4x) × (4x + 1/4x) = 1728

⇒ 64x³ + 1/64x³ + 3 × 1 × 12 = 1728

⇒ 64x³ + 1/64x³ + 36 = 1728

⇒ 64x³ + 1/64x³ = 1728 − 36 = 1692

Dividing the entire equation by 4 to get the required form:

⇒ (64x³ + 1/64x³) ÷ 4 = 1692 ÷ 4

⇒ 16x³ + 1/256x³ = 423

**∴ The correct answer is 423.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Square Identity

If k + 1/k = n, then k² + 1/k² = n² − 2. This is derived from (k + 1/k)² = k² + 1/k² + 2.

Difference Cube Identity

If k − 1/k = n, then k³ − 1/k³ = n³ + 3n. This is derived from (k − 1/k)³ = k³ − 1/k³ − 3(k − 1/k).

Higher Power Relation

To find k⁴ + 1/k⁴, square the result of k² + 1/k² and subtract 2, i.e., (k² + 1/k²)² − 2.</p

questions.question: If x + y + z = 2, xy + yz + zx = -11 and xyz = -12, then what is the value of sqrt {{x³} + {y³} + {z³} - 2}?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Use the direct cubic identity: x³ + y³ + z³ − 3xyz = (x + y + z)[(x + y + z)² − 3(xy + yz + zx)]

Substitute values: x³ + y³ + z³ − 3(−12) = 2[2² − 3(−11)]

⇒ x³ + y³ + z³ + 36 = 2[4 + 33] = 2 × 37 = 74

⇒ x³ + y³ + z³ = 74 − 36 = 38

⇒ Required value = √(38 − 2) = √36 = 6

**∴ The correct answer is 6.**

**__Alternate Method__**

Given: x + y + z = 2, xy + yz + zx = −11, xyz = −12

Formula used: (x + y + z)² = x² + y² + z² + 2(xy + yz + zx)

⇒ 2² = x² + y² + z² + 2(−11)

⇒ 4 = x² + y² + z² − 22

⇒ x² + y² + z² = 26

⇒ x³ + y³ + z³ − 3xyz = (x + y + z)(x² + y² + z² − (xy + yz + zx))

⇒ x³ + y³ + z³ − 3(−12) = 2(26 − (−11))

⇒ x³ + y³ + z³ + 36 = 2(26 + 11)

⇒ x³ + y³ + z³ + 36 = 2 × 37 = 74

⇒ x³ + y³ + z³ = 38

⇒ Expression = √(x³ + y³ + z³ − 2)

⇒ Expression = √(38 − 2) = √36 = 6

**∴ The correct answer is 6.**

**__Additional Information__**

Algebraic Identity for Cubes

The formula a³ + b³ + c³ − 3abc = (a + b + c)(a² + b² + c² − ab − bc − ca) is a fundamental identity used to solve symmetric equations.

Special Case: a + b + c = 0

If the sum of three variables is zero (a + b + c = 0), then the sum of their cubes equals three times their product: a³ + b³ + c³ = 3abc.

Square of a Trinomial

The square of a sum of three terms is given by (a + b + c)² = a² + b² + c² + 2(ab + bc + ca).</p

questions.question: The average of 33 numbers is 74. The average of the first 17 numbers is 72.8 and that of the last 17 numbers is 77.2 If the 17th number is excluded, then what will be the average of the remaining numbers (correct to one decimal place)?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Net deviation from the original average (74):

First 17 numbers: 17 × (72.8 − 74) = 17 × (−1.2) = −20.4

Last 17 numbers: 17 × (77.2 − 74) = 17 × (+3.2) = +54.4

Excess value of 17th number = −20.4 + 54.4 = 34

Average of remaining 32 numbers = 74 − (Excess ÷ Remaining Count) = 74 − (34 ÷ 32) = 74 − 1.0625 = 72.9375

**∴ The correct answer is 72.9.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total numbers (n) = 33 | Average = 74

First 17 numbers average = 72.8 | Last 17 numbers average = 77.2

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c9ea889f59588fdd799689a8b4e6aad36728aaffa4673b7a5ce86b7f3b0426a2.png] 

Formula used: Sum = Average × Number of items

⇒ Sum of all 33 numbers = 33 × 74 = 2442

⇒ Sum of first 17 numbers = 17 × 72.8 = 1237.6

⇒ Sum of last 17 numbers = 17 × 77.2 = 1312.4

⇒ Sum of (first 17 + last 17) numbers = 1237.6 + 1312.4 = 2550

⇒ 17th number = 2550 − 2442 = 108

⇒ Sum of remaining 32 numbers = 2442 − 108 = 2334

⇒ New Average = 2334 ÷ 32 = 72.9375

⇒ New Average (rounded) ≈ 72.9

**∴ The correct answer is 72.9.**

**__Additional Information__**

Net Deviation Method

In any group, the sum of deviations of all observations from their mean is always zero (∑(xᵢ − xₐvg) = 0).

Effect of Exclusion

If a number greater than the average is excluded, the new average decreases. If a number smaller than the average is excluded, the new average increases.

New Average Formula

New Average = (Old Sum − Excluded Value) ÷ (Original Count − 1)</p

Area of equilateral triangle = (√3/4) × s²

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8959991b4cb3c9a7a3d9ba53a8a601f0866e9ce3c53aaeacb6085fcc365c03f4.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Base Area = (√3 / 4) × 8 × 8

⇒ Base Area = (√3 / 4) × 64

⇒ Base Area = 16√3 cm²

⇒ Volume = (1/3) × 16√3 × 24√3

⇒ Volume = (1/3) × 16 × 24 × 3

Slant Height and Slant Edge

Slant height (l) is √(h² + r²) where r is the inradius of the base. Slant edge (e) is √(h² + R²) where R is the circumradius.

Surface Area of Pyramid

Lateral Surface Area = (1/2) × Perimeter of base × Slant height. Total Surface Area = LSA + Base Area.

Prism vs Pyramid Volume

The volume of a pyramid is exactly one-third of the volume of a prism with the same base area and height (V = Base Area × h).</p

questions.question: By selling two articles for Rs. 800, a person gains the cost price of three articles. The profit percent is:

Profit is given in terms of the Cost Price (CP) of 3 articles.

Number of articles sold = 2.

Profit % = (Gain in articles / Number of articles sold) × 100

Profit % = (3 / 2) × 100 = 1.5 × 100 = 150%.

**∴ The correct answer is 150%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

⇒ Total CP of 2 articles = ₹2x

⇒ Gain = CP of 3 articles = ₹3x

⇒ Formula for Profit % = (Profit ÷ CP) × 100

⇒ Profit % = 3/2 × 100

Profit and Loss on Cost Price

Marked Price and Discount

questions.question: A man sells his goods at a certain price at 20% profit. If the price at which he buys the goods increases by 10% and he sells them at an 8% higher price, then what will be his profit percent (correct to one decimal place)?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**17.8**__
**__Key Points__**
__

• Assume the **Initial Cost Price (CP)** of the goods is 100 units.

• Since the man sells the goods at a **20% profit**, the **Initial Selling Price (SP)** is calculated as: 100 + (20% of 100) = 120 units.

• The problem states that the **New Cost Price (CP)** increases by 10%. Thus, the New CP = 100 + (10% of 100) = 110 units.

• The man then sells them at an **8% higher price** than the initial selling price. The **New Selling Price (SP)** = 120 + (8% of 120).

• Calculating 8% of 120: (8 ÷ 100) * 120 = 9.6. So, the New SP = 120 + 9.6 = 129.6 units.

• The **New Profit** earned is the difference between the New SP and the New CP: 129.6 − 110 = 19.6 units.

• To find the **Profit Percentage**, we use the formula: (Profit ÷ New CP) * 100.

• Calculation: (19.6 ÷ 110) * 100 = 1960 ÷ 110 = 17.818...%

• When rounded to **one decimal place**, the profit percent is **17.8%**.

**Additional Information__**

• **Profit** is defined as the surplus amount gained when the **Selling Price (SP)** exceeds the **Cost Price (CP)**. Formula: Profit = SP − CP.

• The **Profit Percentage** is always calculated on the **Cost Price** unless specifically mentioned otherwise in the problem. Formula: Profit % = (Profit ÷ CP) * 100.

• When there is a **Percentage Increase** in a value, the new value can be found using: New Value = Original Value * (1 + Rate ÷ 100). For an 8% increase on 120: 120 * (1 + 8 ÷ 100) = 120 * 1.08 = 129.6.

questions.question: The value of (tan29° cot61° – cosec²61°) + cot²54° – sec²36° + (sin²1° + sin²3° + sin²5° + ---------- + sin²89°) is:
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Term 1: tan 29° cot 61° − cosec² 61° = cot² 61° − cosec² 61° = −1

Term 2: cot² 54° − sec² 36° = cot² 54° − cosec² 54° = −1

Series: sin² 1° + sin² 3° + ... + sin² 89° has n = [(89 − 1) ÷ 2] + 1 = 45 terms.

Value of series = (44 ÷ 2) + sin² 45° = 22 + 1/2 = 22.5.

Final Value = −1 − 1 + 22.5 = 20.5.

**∴ The correct answer is 20 1/2.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** (tan 29° cot 61° − cosec² 61°) + cot² 54° − sec² 36° + (sin² 1° + sin² 3° + ... + sin² 89°)

**Formula Used:** tan A = cot(90 − A); sec A = cosec(90 − A); sin² A + sin²(90 − A) = 1; cot² θ − cosec² θ = −1

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b7ab672adcf16d1a6bb25ce6d8c0c5f173e5d8ae929ed37fbabed6c1c5dca1bd.png] 

⇒ Part 1: tan 29° cot 61° − cosec² 61° = cot 61° × cot 61° − cosec² 61° = cot² 61° − cosec² 61° = −1

⇒ Part 2: cot² 54° − sec² 36° = cot² 54° − cosec² 54° = −1

⇒ Part 3 (Series): sin² 1° + sin² 3° + ... + sin² 89°

⇒ Angle AP: a = 1, d = 2, l = 89. Number of terms n = [(89 − 1) ÷ 2] + 1 = 45.

⇒ Number of complementary pairs (A + B = 90°) = 44 ÷ 2 = 22.

⇒ Sum = (22 × 1) + sin² 45° = 22 + (1/√2)² = 22 + 1/2 = 22.5.

⇒ Total = (−1) + (−1) + 22.5 = 20.5.

**∴ The correct answer is 20 1/2.**

**__Additional Information__**

Complementary Trigonometric Ratios

When A + B = 90°, sin² A + sin² B = 1 and cos² A + cos² B = 1. Also, tan A = cot B and sec A = cosec B.

Fundamental Trigonometric Identities

sin² θ + cos² θ = 1; 1 + tan² θ = sec² θ; 1 + cot² θ = cosec² θ.

Terms in a Series

For an arithmetic progression, the number of terms n = [(Last term − First term) ÷ Common difference] + 1.</p

questions.question: The graphs of the equations 2x + 3y = 11 and x – 2y + 12 = 0 intersects at P(x₁, y₁) and the graph of the equation x – 2y + 12 = 0 intersects the x-axis at Q(x₂, y₂). What is the value of (x₁ – x₂ + y₁ + y₂)?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Solve 2x + 3y = 11 and x − 2y = −12 simultaneously by multiplying second equation by 2: 2x − 4y = −24.

Subtracting both: (2x + 3y) − (2x − 4y) = 11 − (−24) ⇒ 7y = 35 ⇒ y₁ = 5 and x₁ = −2.

For point Q on x-axis in x − 2y + 12 = 0, put y = 0 ⇒ x₂ = −12 and y₂ = 0.

Required value = x₁ − x₂ + y₁ + y₂ = −2 − (−12) + 5 + 0 = 15.

**∴ The correct answer is 15.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Line 1: 2x + 3y = 11

Line 2: x − 2y + 12 = 0

P(x₁, y₁) is the intersection of Line 1 and Line 2.

Q(x₂, y₂) is the intersection of Line 2 and the x-axis.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6133f8cc4bb70d4e1cbf1143d24936752af51fef1f63a2b2216968dfddfd4e0a.png] 

**Step 1: Finding coordinates of P(x₁, y₁)**

Multiply x − 2y = −12 by 2:

⇒ 2x − 4y = −24 --- (i)

Given first equation:

⇒ 2x + 3y = 11 --- (ii)

Subtract (i) from (ii):

⇒ (2x + 3y) − (2x − 4y) = 11 − (−24)

⇒ 7y = 35 ⇒ y₁ = 5

Substitute y = 5 in Line 2:

⇒ x − 2(5) + 12 = 0

⇒ x − 10 + 12 = 0 ⇒ x₁ = −2

⇒ P(x₁, y₁) = (−2, 5)

**Step 2: Finding coordinates of Q(x₂, y₂)**

Since Q lies on the x-axis, y-coordinate y₂ = 0.

Substitute y = 0 in equation of Line 2: x − 2y + 12 = 0

⇒ x − 2(0) + 12 = 0

⇒ x + 12 = 0 ⇒ x₂ = −12

⇒ Q(x₂, y₂) = (−12, 0)

**Step 3: Calculating the required value**

⇒ (x₁ − x₂ + y₁ + y₂)

⇒ (−2 − (−12) + 5 + 0)

⇒ −2 + 12 + 5 + 0 = 15

**∴ The correct answer is 15.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Intersection of Two Lines

The point of intersection of two linear equations a₁x + b₁y + c₁ = 0 and a₂x + b₂y + c₂ = 0 is found by solving them simultaneously as a system of equations.

Intercepts on Axes

To find the x-intercept of a line, set y = 0. To find the y-intercept, set x = 0. A point on the x-axis always has the form (x, 0).

Condition for Parallel Lines

Two lines a₁x + b₁y + c₁ = 0 and a₂x + b₂y + c₂ = 0 are parallel if their slopes are equal, i.e., a₁/a₂ = b₁/b₂ ≠ c₁/c₂.</p

questions.question: Places A and B are 396 km apart. Train X leaves from A for B and train Y leaves from B for A at the same time on the same day on parallel tracks. Both trains meet after 5(1)/(2) hours. The speed of Y is 10 km/h more than that of X. What is the speed (in km/h) of Y?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Relative speed of trains = Distance ÷ Time = 396 ÷ 5.5 = 72 km/h.

Since trains move towards each other, Sum of speeds (Y + X) = 72 km/h.

Given Difference of speeds (Y − X) = 10 km/h.

Speed of faster train (Y) = (Sum + Difference) ÷ 2 = (72 + 10) ÷ 2 = 41 km/h.

**∴ The correct answer is 41 km/h.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Distance (D) = 396 km

Time (t) = 5.5 hours

Speed of train Y = Speed of train X + 10 km/h

**Formula:**

Relative Speed = Total Distance ÷ Time taken to meet

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/db8d235dd2d6f4ce4c43469abb38e8ccc72ebe3e0358458188a6d606162f90fa.png] 

⇒ Let speed of Train X be S km/h.

⇒ Speed of Train Y = (S + 10) km/h.

⇒ Relative Speed = S + (S + 10) = 2S + 10 km/h.

⇒ 2S + 10 = 396 ÷ 5.5

⇒ 2S + 10 = 72

⇒ 2S = 72 − 10 = 62

⇒ S = 31 km/h (Speed of Train X)

⇒ Speed of Train Y = 31 + 10 = 41 km/h.

**∴ The correct answer is 41 km/h.**

**__Additional Information__**

Relative Speed in Opposite Directions

When two objects move towards each other, their relative speed is the sum of their individual speeds (S₁ + S₂).

Relative Speed in Same Direction

When two objects move in the same direction, their relative speed is the difference between their individual speeds (S₁ − S₂).

Distance Formula

Distance = Relative Speed × Time. In meeting point problems, the time taken by both to meet is the same if they start simultaneously.</p

questions.question: Train A which was travelling at 50 km/h crosses train B travelling in opposite direction in 15 seconds. If the length of train B is three times the length of A and the speed of train B was 58 km/h, then the length of train A(in m) is∶
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Relative speed in opposite direction = 50 + 58 = 108 km/h

Relative speed in m/s = 108 × 5/18 = 30 m/s

Total distance (LA + LB) = Speed × Time = 30 × 15 = 450 m

Given LB = 3LA, so total length = LA + 3LA = 4LA

4LA = 450 ⇒ LA = 450 ÷ 4 = 112.5 m

**∴ The correct answer is 112.5 m.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Speed of Train A (SA) = 50 km/h

Speed of Train B (SB) = 58 km/h

Time to cross each other (t) = 15 seconds

Length of Train B (LB) = 3 × Length of Train A (LA)

**Formula Used:**

Relative Speed (Opposite Direction) = SA + SB

Total Distance = Length of Train A + Length of Train B

Distance = Speed × Time

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bf1fad83d0bad5455dc1fe94125b463d6954dea1bc670d4be8e00ca608489a17.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Relative speed = 50 + 58 = 108 km/h

⇒ Converting speed to m/s: 108 × (5/18) = 6 × 5 = 30 m/s

⇒ Total distance = (LA + LB)

⇒ LA + 3LA = 30 × 15

⇒ 4LA = 450

⇒ LA = 450 ÷ 4

⇒ LA = 112.5 m

**∴ The correct answer is 112.5 m.**

**__Additional Information__**

Relative Speed Rules

When two objects move in opposite directions, relative speed = S₁ + S₂. When they move in the same direction, relative speed = |S₁ − S₂|.

Unit Conversion

To convert km/h to m/s, multiply by 5/18. To convert m/s to km/h, multiply by 18/5.

Crossing Length

When a train crosses another train, the total distance covered is always the sum of the lengths of both trains, regardless of the direction.</p

questions.question: A can do 40% of a work in 12 days, whereas B can do 60% of the same work in 15 days. Both works together for 10 days. C completes the remaining work alone in 4 days. A, B and C together will complete 28% of the same work in∶
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Total time: A = 12 ÷ 0.4 = 30 days, B = 15 ÷ 0.6 = 25 days.

Let Total Work = LCM(30, 25) = 150 units. Efficiencies: A = 5, B = 6.

(A+B) in 10 days = (5 + 6) × 10 = 110. Rem. work = 150 − 110 = 40.

C's Efficiency = 40 ÷ 4 = 10. Total Efficiency (A+B+C) = 5 + 6 + 10 = 21.

Time for 28% work = (150 × 0.28) ÷ 21 = 42 ÷ 21 = 2 days.

**∴ The correct answer is 2 days.**

**__Alternate Method__**

Given:

A completes 40% in 12 days ⇒ 100% in (12 × 100) ÷ 40 = 30 days.

B completes 60% in 15 days ⇒ 100% in (15 × 100) ÷ 60 = 25 days.

⇒ Remaining work left for C = 150 − 110 = 40 units.

⇒ Combined efficiency of A, B and C = 5 + 6 + 10 = 21 units/day.

Efficiency and Time Relation

The time taken to complete a work is inversely proportional to the efficiency. Work = Efficiency × Time.

Combined Efficiency

When multiple people work together, their combined efficiency is the sum of their individual efficiencies (Total Efficiency = E₁ + E₂ + ...).

Percentage Work calculation

[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The expression is in the form √[a + b + c + 2(√ab + √bc + √ca)], which is √(a + b + c)².

Compare the signs of the products: 2(√6 − √10 − √15).

Positive term √6 comes from √2 × √3. Negative terms −√10 and −√15 share −√5 as a common factor.

Thus, the terms are √3, √2, and −√5.

Sum of squares = 3 + 2 + 5 = 10, which matches the constant term.

**∴ The correct answer is √3 + √2 − √5.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** √[10 + 2(√6 − √10 − √15)]

**Formula Used:** (x + y + z)² = x² + y² + z² + 2(xy + yz + zx)

Let x = √3, y = √2, and z = −√5.

⇒ x² + y² + z² = (√3)² + (√2)² + (−√5)² = 3 + 2 + 5 = 10

⇒ 2(xy + yz + zx) = 2[(√3 × √2) + (√2 × −√5) + (−√5 × √3)]

⇒ 2(xy + yz + zx) = 2(√6 − √10 − √15)

Substituting these into the given expression:

⇒ √[10 + 2(√6 − √10 − √15)] = √[(√3 + √2 − √5)²]

⇒ √3 + √2 − √5

**∴ The correct answer is √3 + √2 − √5.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Square of a Trinomial

The formula (a + b + c)² = a² + b² + c² + 2ab + 2bc + 2ca helps in simplifying nested radicals with three irrational terms.

Simplification rule for Surds

When simplifying √(x ± 2√y), look for two numbers whose sum is x and product is y, then the result is √a ± √b.

Always solve terms inside the innermost brackets first, followed by orders (roots/powers), then division, multiplication, addition, and subtraction.</p

questions.question: The sides of a triangle are 56 cm, 90 cm and 106 cm. The circumference of its circumcircle is∶

Check for Pythagorean triplet: 56² + 90² = 3136 + 8100 = 11236 = 106².

Since the triangle is right-angled, the circumradius R = Hypotenuse ÷ 2 = 106 ÷ 2 = 53 cm.

Circumference of circumcircle = 2 × π × R = 2 × π × 53 = 106π cm.

**∴ The correct answer is 106π cm.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Sides of the triangle: a = 56 cm, b = 90 cm, c = 106 cm.

**Formula Used:**

For a right-angled triangle, the circumradius (R) = Hypotenuse ÷ 2.

**Calculations:**

⇒ First, we check if the triangle is right-angled using Pythagoras theorem:

⇒ a² + b² = 56² + 90² = 3136 + 8100 = 11236

⇒ c² = 106² = 11236

⇒ Since a² + b² = c², the triangle is right-angled at the vertex opposite to the 106 cm side.

⇒ In a right-angled triangle, the circumcircle passes through all vertices, and the hypotenuse is the diameter.

⇒ Diameter (d) = Hypotenuse = 106 cm

⇒ Circumradius (R) = 106 ÷ 2 = 53 cm

⇒ Circumference = 2 × π × R = π × d

⇒ Circumference = 106π cm

**∴ The correct answer is 106π cm.**

**__Additional Information__**

Circumradius of any Triangle

For any triangle with sides a, b, c and area A, the circumradius R = (a × b × c) ÷ (4 × A).

questions.question: If frac{{1 + sin phi }}{{1 - sin phi }} = frac{{{p²}}}{{{q²}}}, then sec ϕ is equal to∶
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Apply Componendo and Dividendo to (1 + sin ϕ) / (1 − sin ϕ) = p² / q².

1 / sin ϕ = (p² + q²) / (p² − q²) ⇒ sin ϕ = (p² − q²) / (p² + q²).

Recognize the Pythagorean triplet: Perpendicular = p² − q², Hypotenuse = p² + q², Base = 2pq.

sec ϕ = Hypotenuse / Base = (p² + q²) / 2pq.

Splitting the terms: sec ϕ = p²/2pq + q²/2pq = 1/2 (p/q + q/p).

**∴ The correct answer is 1/2 (p/q + q/p).**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** (1 + sin ϕ) / (1 − sin ϕ) = p² / q²

**Formula Used:** Componendo and Dividendo: If a/b = c/d, then (a + b) / (a − b) = (c + d) / (c − d). Also, sec ϕ = 1 / cos ϕ.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4032e93f1a741897dbbf0b47867f78bc446c2755d6894c2ec7178452bcd26c91.png] 

⇒ Applying Componendo and Dividendo:

⇒ [(1 + sin ϕ) + (1 − sin ϕ)] / [(1 + sin ϕ) − (1 − sin ϕ)] = (p² + q²) / (p² − q²)

⇒ 2 / 2sin ϕ = (p² + q²) / (p² − q²)

⇒ 1 / sin ϕ = (p² + q²) / (p² − q²) ⇒ sin ϕ = (p² − q²) / (p² + q²)

⇒ Since sin ϕ = Perpendicular / Hypotenuse, we have P = p² − q² and H = p² + q².

⇒ Base (B) = √[H² − P²] = √[(p² + q²)² − (p² − q²)²]

⇒ B = √[4p²q²] = 2pq

⇒ sec ϕ = Hypotenuse / Base = (p² + q²) / 2pq

⇒ sec ϕ = p² / 2pq + q² / 2pq = p/2q + q/2p = 1/2 (p/q + q/p)

**∴ The correct answer is 1/2 (p/q + q/p).**

**__Additional Information__**

Componendo and Dividendo Rule

It is a theorem on proportions that allows for the simplification of equations of the form (a+b)/(a−b) = k.

Pythagorean Triplet for Algebra

The set of values (p² − q²), 2pq, and (p² + q²) always forms a right-angled triangle triplet.

Reciprocal Trigonometric Ratios

The secant function (sec ϕ) is the reciprocal of the cosine function (cos ϕ = Base/Hypotenuse), so sec ϕ = Hypotenuse/Base.

questions.question: If 60% of a number is 120 more than 20% of the number, then 28% of the number is less than 33(1)/(3)\% of the number by∶
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Difference in given percentages: 60% − 20% = 40%

Value of 40% = 120 ⇒ 1% = 120 ÷ 40 = 3

Required gap: 33¹/₃% − 28% = 5¹/₃%

Target Value = 3 × 5¹/₃ = 3 × (16/3) = 16

**∴ The correct answer is 16.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Difference between 60% and 20% of a number is 120.

**Formula Used:** Value = (Percentage ÷ 100) × Number

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f8ab88808b76cc0210875874202c12044683426f95d3c2365bcc2b552454b3da.png] 

⇒ Let the number be x.

⇒ (60/100) × x − (20/100) × x = 120

⇒ (40/100) × x = 120

⇒ x = (120 × 100) ÷ 40 = 300

⇒ 33¹/₃% of 300 = (1/3) × 300 = 100

⇒ 28% of 300 = (28/100) × 300 = 84

⇒ Difference = 100 − 84 = 16

**∴ The correct answer is 16.**

**__Additional Information__**

Fraction to Percentage Conversion

Standard fractions simplify calculations: 1/3 = 33¹/₃%, 1/4 = 25%, 1/5 = 20%.

% Change = [(New Value − Old Value) ÷ Old Value] × 100.</p

questions.question: The base of a right prism is a triangle with sides 20 cm, 21 cm and 29 cm. If its volume is 7560 cm³, then its lateral surface area (in cm²) is∶

**Calculations:**

⇒ Base is a right triangle as 20² + 21² = 400 + 441 = 841 = 29².

⇒ Area of Base = 1/2 × Base × Height = 1/2 × 21 × 20 = 210 cm².

⇒ Height (h) of the prism = Volume ÷ Area of Base.

⇒ h = 7560 ÷ 210 = 36 cm.

⇒ Perimeter of triangular base = 20 + 21 + 29 = 70 cm.

⇒ Lateral Surface Area = Perimeter × h = 70 × 36 = 2520 cm².

questions.question: In ΔABC, the perpendiculars are drawn from A, B and C to meet the opposite sides at D, E and F, respectively AD, BE and CF intersect at point p. If ∠EPD = 116° and the bisectors of ∠A and ∠B meet at Q, then the measure of ∠AQB is:

questions.question: The sum of the interior angles of a regular polygon is 1260°. What is the difference between an exterior angle and an interior angle of the polygon?

Sum of interior angles = (n − 2) × 180° = 1260° → n − 2 = 7 → n = 9 sides.

Exterior angle (E) = 360° ÷ 9 = 40°.

Interior angle (I) = 180° − 40° = 140°.

Difference = 140° − 40° = 100°.

**∴ The correct answer is 100°.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a6e09f4c1594db3d99917a77db9510dc9a711def55d0c48880b900c245e2f286.png] 

⇒ (n − 2) × 180° = 1260°

⇒ n − 2 = 1260 ÷ 180

⇒ n − 2 = 7

⇒ n = 9

⇒ Interior angle = 1260° ÷ 9 = 140°

⇒ Exterior angle = 360° ÷ 9 = 40°

⇒ Difference = 140° − 40° = 100°

**∴ The correct answer is 100°.**

Sum of Exterior Angles

For any convex polygon, the sum of all exterior angles is always 360°.

The number of diagonals in a polygon with n sides is given by the formula: [n × (n − 3)] ÷ 2.</p

questions.question: In a circle, AB and DC are two chords. When AB and DC are produced, they meet at P. If PC = 5.6 cm, PB = 6.3 cm and AB = 7.7 cm, then the length of CD is∶

88.2 = 31.36 + 5.6 × CD ⇒ 5.6 × CD = 56.84.

External segment PB = 6.3 cm

⇒ Now, PD = PC + CD

⇒ 15.75 = 5.6 + CD

⇒ CD = 15.75 − 5.6

questions.question: The value of sqrt {frac{{cosec phi - cot phi }}{{cosec phi + cot phi }}} div frac{{sin phi }}{{1 + cos phi }} is equal to∶
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Use the value substitution method by picking a standard angle for φ.

Let φ = 90°. Then, sin 90° = 1, cos 90° = 0, cosec 90° = 1, and cot 90° = 0.

Substitute these values into the expression: √((1 − 0) / (1 + 0)) ÷ (1 / (1 + 0))

⇒ √(1 / 1) ÷ (1 / 1) ⇒ 1 ÷ 1 = 1.

**∴ The correct answer is 1.**

**__Alternate Method__**

Given expression: √((cosec φ − cot φ) / (cosec φ + cot φ)) ÷ (sin φ / (1 + cos φ))

First, rationalize the term inside the square root:

⇒ √[((cosec φ − cot φ) / (cosec φ + cot φ)) × ((cosec φ − cot φ) / (cosec φ − cot φ))]

⇒ √[(cosec φ − cot φ)² / (cosec² φ − cot² φ)]

Using the identity cosec² φ − cot² φ = 1:

⇒ √[(cosec φ − cot φ)² / 1] = cosec φ − cot φ

Now, express the result in terms of sin φ and cos φ:

⇒ cosec φ − cot φ = (1 / sin φ) − (cos φ / sin φ) = (1 − cos φ) / sin φ

Substitute this back into the original expression:

⇒ [(1 − cos φ) / sin φ] ÷ [sin φ / (1 + cos φ)]

⇒ [(1 − cos φ) / sin φ] × [(1 + cos φ) / sin φ]

⇒ (1 − cos² φ) / sin² φ

Using the identity 1 − cos² φ = sin² φ:

⇒ sin² φ / sin² φ = 1

**∴ The correct answer is 1.**

Fundamental Trigonometric Identities

cosec φ = 1/sin φ, sec φ = 1/cos φ, tan φ = sin φ/cos φ, and cot φ = cos φ/sin φ.

Half-Angle Tangent Formula

tan(φ/2) = (1 − cos φ) / sin φ = sin φ / (1 + cos φ). The given problem essentially divides tan(φ/2) by tan(φ/2).</p

questions.question:
A field roller, in the shape of a cylinder, has a diameter of 1 m and length of 1(1)/(4) m.

If the speed at which the roller rolls is 14 revolutions per minute, then the maximum area (in m²) that it can roll in 1 hour is: (Take π = 22/7)

[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total Area = (Revolutions per minute × Total minutes) × (Curved Surface Area)

Curved Surface Area per revolution = π × d × h = (22/7) × 1 × 1.25 m²

Total Revolutions in 1 hour = 14 × 60 = 840

Total Area = 840 × (22/7) × 1 × 1.25 = 120 × 22 × 1.25 = 3300 m²

**∴ The correct answer is 3300 m².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Diameter (d) = 1 m ⇒ Radius (r) = 0.5 m

Length (h) = 1¼ m = 1.25 m

Rolling speed = 14 revolutions/min

Time = 1 hour = 60 minutes

Curved Surface Area of Cylinder = 2 × π × r × h

Total Area = Revolutions in 1 min × Total minutes × Area per revolution

⇒ Area per revolution = (22/7) × 1 × 1.25 = 27.5/7 m²

⇒ Total revolutions in 1 hour = 14 × 60 = 840

⇒ Maximum area rolled = 840 × (27.5 / 7)

⇒ Maximum area rolled = 120 × 27.5

Curved Surface Area (CSA)

For a cylinder, CSA = 2πrh. This represents the area of the side surface excluding the circular bases.

Total Surface Area (TSA)

Volume of Cylinder

Rolling Area Concept

When a cylinder rolls without slipping, the area covered in N revolutions is N × CSA.</p

questions.question: In ΔABC, AB = AC and D is a point on BC. If BD = 5 cm, AB = 12 cm and AD = 8 cm, then the length of CD is∶
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

CD = 80 ÷ 5 = 16 cm.

**∴ The correct answer is 16 cm.**

⇒ 12² × 5 + 12² × CD = (5 + CD) × (8² + 5 × CD)

⇒ 144 × (5 + CD) = (5 + CD) × (64 + 5 × CD)

Dividing both sides by (5 + CD):

⇒ 144 = 64 + 5 × CD

⇒ 5 × CD = 144 − 64

⇒ 5 × CD = 80

⇒ CD = 80 ÷ 5

⇒ CD = 16 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 16 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b7ed089587a34f9dfef48459e6281164aa9b803f55fbf017d150242a0cb7cea7.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Volume of water in cubic meters = 15400 ÷ 1000 = 15.4 m³

⇒ Let the drop in water level be h meters.

⇒ 15.4 = (22/7) × (3.5)² × h

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Volume of Cylinder

The volume of a cylinder is given by V = πr²h, where r is the radius and h is the height.

Surface Area of Cylinder

Curved Surface Area (CSA) = 2πrh; Total Surface Area (TSA) = 2πr(r + h).

Metric Conversions
